passages_found.quote: While the former envisions an overt AI takeover pathway, characterized by scenarios like uncontrollable superintelligence, the latter suggests a different pathway to existential catastrophes.
However, my core argument about the nature of x-risks holds whether we consider AGI/ASI or narrower AI systems with extreme, uncontrollable capabilities in specific domains.
Computer scientists such as Stuart Russell (2019) and physicists like Max Tegmark (2018) echoed similar concerns, stressing the x-risks of ASI beyond human control.
